Tendrán la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades, aprender de los mejores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de un día inolvidable rodeados de personas apasionadas como ustedes. No importa si es tu primera vez participando en un campeonato o si ya eres un veterano de la resolución de cubos, ¡Todos son bienvenidos! **English** It is a pleasure to welcome Montealegre Winter 2023. In this third edition, we meet once again at the prestigious Teatro Montealegre to celebrate our shared passion for this challenging color puzzle. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your skills, learn from the best and, above all, enjoy an unforgettable day surrounded by passionate people like you. Whether it's your first time participating in a championship or you're already a veteran solving Rubik's cubes, everyone is welcome!

items.information: This competition is on a **Thursday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).
